description: Count how many clips and hours match a filter set for a dataset tier, with the fixed price. Free, reserves nothing, needs no buyer details. Use it to iterate on filters before quoting.

countries.description: Country names as they appear in the catalog, e.g. ["United States", "France"]

decades.description: Decades to include, e.g. ["1950s", "1960s"]. Default: all six, 1930s–1980s.

exclude_logos.description: Exclude clips with logos or trademarks (implies reviewed_only)

exclude_minors.description: Exclude clips where minors are visible (implies reviewed_only)

exclude_music.description: Exclude clips with audible music (implies reviewed_only)

exclude_people.description: Exclude clips where people are visible (implies reviewed_only)

max_clips.description: Cap the selection at this many clips (stable pseudo-random sample of the matches)

max_risk.description: Highest clearance risk to include: low, medium, or high (default)

query.description: Free text matched against titles, descriptions, and keywords

require_4k_master.description: Only clips with a restored 4K master online (forced on for 4k media)

reviewed_only.description: Only clips with clearance flags populated. Default true.

media_resolution.description: proxy (watermarked 256x144 analysis MP4s, default) or 4k (restored masters, commercial tier only, always paid by bank wire; limits the set to clips with a master online)

tier.description: evaluation (free, ≤100 clips, proxies), research ($25,000 flat, ≤25,000 clips, proxies, accredited academic institutions only), or commercial ($3.00/clip proxies or $10.00/clip 4K masters, $10,000 minimum, ≤50,000 clips). Default commercial.

name: scope_training_dataset
